options.name: Ko-fi
options.headline: A one-off thank you, with no strings
options.summary: A single, one-off thank you. No subscription, nothing to cancel, and no perks attached — which is entirely the point.
body: If you've got something useful out of a video or an article and you'd like to say thanks, this is the simplest way to do it. Give what you like, once, and that's the end of it.
It goes straight back into the channel: the gear that gets torn apart on camera, the parts that don't survive the process, and the hosting bills behind this site.
options.perksNote: No rewards, no tiers, no ongoing commitment.

options.name: YouTube membership
options.headline: Support from where you're already watching
options.summary: A monthly membership through YouTube itself, so it's handled by the same account you already watch on.
body: If you'd rather not juggle another account, this is the least fiddly option. It's billed through YouTube alongside everything else you're subscribed to.
options.tiersNote: Early access isn't guaranteed — it depends on how far ahead I am, which varies. Treat it as a bonus when it happens rather than something to count on.

tiers.name: Supporter
tiers.summary: Chipping in each month to keep the channel going, with a role on the Discord server to show for it.
perks: A supporter role on the Discord server

tiers.name: Super Fan
tiers.summary: Everything the Supporter tier does, plus the extras.
perks: Members-only rooms on the Discord server
A discount in the merch store

options.name: Patreon
options.headline: Pick a level that suits you
options.summary: The most involved option, and the one with the most on offer. Three tiers, each building on the one before it.
body: Patreon is where the deeper stuff lives: voting on what gets made next, early access as standard, and at the top tier a seat in the room where videos actually get planned.

tiers.name: Lab Assistant
tiers.summary: You're saying thank you, and you're very welcome. You'll get your role on the Discord server.

tiers.name: Senior Technician
tiers.summary: Everything in Lab Assistant, plus a say in what gets made, a head start on watching it, and your name on screen.
perks: Private Discord channels, where upcoming content gets shaped
Voting rights on how videos get prioritised
Early access to every video, usually at least 24 hours
Member-only videos, including behind the scenes
A shout-out credit in selected videos

tiers.name: Scientist
tiers.summary: Everything in Senior Technician, plus a run of the Discord server and a seat at the table.
perks: Extra powers on the Discord server
An exclusive channel for thumbnail ideas, video pitches and planning
Group video calls to talk tech and the channel
